clips.speaker: Mohit Mipuri
clips.title: SGMC资本Mohit：印尼市场暂避降级风险，改革落地是关键
title_lines: 印尼市场暂避降级风险

subtitles.en: Indonesia has avoided the immediate downgrade risk, but the announcement came with a clear warning label.
subtitles.zh: 印尼避免了立即降级风险，但声明附带了明确警告。

subtitles.en: In fairness, as you pointed out, the accessibility scores last week do not paint the picture of a market that belongs in the frontier market.
subtitles.zh: 公平地说，上周的可及性评分并不表明该市场属于前沿市场。

subtitles.en: The vast majority of Indonesia's framework remains intact.
subtitles.zh: 印尼的大部分框架仍然完好。

subtitles.en: The deterioration was concentrated around the information flow and shareholder transparency concerns.
subtitles.zh: 恶化集中在信息流通和股东透明度问题上。

subtitles.en: The reforms by OJK, IDX and KSA, the focus is now on implementation, consistency, and sustained effectiveness.
subtitles.zh: OJK、IDX和KSA的改革，现在重点是实施、一致性和持续有效性。

subtitles.en: MSCI reviews markets in practice, not on paper.
subtitles.zh: MSCI在实践中审查市场，而非纸上谈兵。

subtitles.en: It would be too soon given the reforms would just occur in March and April. So, now, it's about clear implementation and ensuring that all of this is fully practice.
subtitles.zh: 考虑到改革刚刚在3月和4月进行，现在还为时过早。所以，现在关键是明确实施并确保这一切完全落实。

clips.speaker: Mohit Mipuri
clips.title: SGMC资本Mohit：印尼市场估值吸引，悲观中孕育机会

subtitles.en: November is now the next key date. Investors will still have to deal with the volatility that this tail risk brings.
subtitles.zh: 11月现在是下一个关键日期。投资者仍需应对尾部风险带来的波动。

subtitles.en: This is not January 2026 when markets were at all-time highs. We are now at levels that already reflect a lot of this risk.
subtitles.zh: 这不是2026年1月市场处于历史高位的时候。我们现在处于已经反映了很多风险的价位。
en_highlights: reflect a lot of this risk

subtitles.en: JCI is down 32% in dollar terms as of yesterday, even after rebounding about 17% from the 8 June low.
subtitles.zh: 截至昨日，雅加达综合指数以美元计下跌32%，即使已从6月8日低点反弹约17%。

subtitles.en: The market is trading around nine times forward earnings, valuations are appealing, positioning is light, and expectations are low.
subtitles.zh: 市场交易在约9倍远期收益，估值吸引人，仓位轻，预期低。

subtitles.en: These are typically good ingredients for an investor to work with.
subtitles.zh: 这些通常是投资者可以利用的好因素。

subtitles.en: Our message is simple. Don't stay selective, but don't be paralyzed by the headlines.
subtitles.zh: 我们的信息很简单。保持选择性，但不要被头条新闻吓倒。

clips.speaker: Mohit Mipuri
clips.title: SGMC资本Mohit：印尼改革需证明实效，重建信心是关键

subtitles.en: The proof is in the pudding now, so to speak.
subtitles.zh: 可以说，现在要用事实说话。

subtitles.en: Indonesia and the new chiefs need to show MSCI and international investors that the reforms are not just announcements, but are working in practice.
subtitles.zh: 印尼和新任领导需要向MSCI和国际投资者表明，改革不仅仅是宣布，而是在实践中发挥作用。

subtitles.en: That means better transparency around shareholding structures, more reliability, more free float visibility, stronger disclosure standards.
subtitles.zh: 这意味着股权结构更透明、更可靠、自由流通股更清晰、披露标准更强。

subtitles.en: MSCI also mentioned they wanted a lot of things in English. So, all these rules just need to be applied consistently.
subtitles.zh: MSCI还提到他们希望很多内容用英文。所以，所有这些规则都需要一致应用。

subtitles.en: The other point is policy credibility. Indonesia cannot just rely on these cheap valuations to bring investors back.
subtitles.zh: 另一点是政策可信度。印尼不能仅仅依靠低廉的估值来吸引投资者回归。

subtitles.en: It needs to rebuild confidence to fiscal discipline and to consistency in the communication from regulators.
subtitles.zh: 它需要重建对财政纪律和监管机构沟通一致性的信心。

subtitles.en: If Indonesia can show progress by November, the conversation can shift from downgrade risk to recovery.
subtitles.zh: 如果印尼能在11月前展示进展，讨论就可以从降级风险转向复苏。
